newsitem.title: USA: Home Health Corp to buy 3 Texas firms.
newsitem.headline: Home Health Corp to buy 3 Texas firms.

text.p: Home Health Corp of America Inc said Friday that it has signed a term sheet to acquire the assets of a subsidiary and two affiliated companies of LHS Holdings Inc, located in Dallas/Ft. Worth, Texas.
The three companies have total annualized revenues of $24.0 million.
Home Health said it will acquire Liberty Health Services Inc, a subsidiary of LHS, which is a Medicare certified home health agency.
The acquisition also includes two affiliates of LHS, PDN Inc, a pediatric private duty nursing agency, and Medical IV Inc, a home infusion therapy company, Home Health said.
The company said it expects to sign a definitive agreement within 60 days.
